precepts.text: Paul went days without eating, and when he had received meat, he was strengthened; food and drink after the trial revive the servant of the Most High.
precepts.point: He called the name of that place En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

precepts.why: When Samson had drunk, “his spirit came again, and he revived”. You kill a thousand men with a jawbone, you are going to be parched. It is the same as after a fast, when the first food and drink make you feel like a whole new person. Paul went days without eating, “And when he had received meat, he was strengthened.” Food and drink after the trial revive the servant of the Most High. Samson called on the Lord in his thirst, God clave an hollow place in the jaw and gave him water, and he called the name of that place En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

points: Within a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a kid and said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. He knew she had betrayed him and still went back to her; a weakness for a woman really does beat on Israelite men.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Her father would not suffer him to go in, saying, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her, therefore I gave her to thy companion; is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Samson said concerning them, now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure; he was set to avenge himself.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes by himself, took firebrands, turned the foxes tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: When he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines and burnt up both the shocks and the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives; their food source and their wine source, all of it, because they crossed him.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: The Philistines asked who had done this, and were told, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife and given her to his companion.
The Philistines came up and burnt her and her father with fire; the very thing she betrayed her husband to escape came upon her from her own people.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Samson said unto them, though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease; he would get the last word.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: He smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter, dropping them like flies, and went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: The Philistines went up and pitched in Judah and spread themselves in Lehi, and the men of Judah asked, why are ye come up against us? We are already under tribute; what is the problem? They answered, to bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us. Samson was not even of Judah; he was a Danite.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam and said to Samson, knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? Instead of standing with their brother, the whole tribe came to hand him over to the oppressor.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: He answered, as they did unto me, so have I done unto them. He let them bind him, only making them swear that they would not fall upon him themselves, and they bound him with two new cords and brought him up from the rock.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: When he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him, and the spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him: the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: He found a new jawbone of an ass, put forth his hand and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith. This is not normal; you have not seen this in any comic book. One man against a thousand, and all he had was the jawbone of a donkey, and he laid all of them down.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Samson said, with the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: When he had made an end of speaking, he cast away the jawbone out of his hand and called that place Ramath-lehi.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: He was sore athirst and called on the Lord: thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant, and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised? You kill a thousand men with a jawbone, you are going to be parched.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. It is the same as after a fast, when the first food and drink make you feel like a whole new person.
He called the name of that place En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

note.label: Judges 15: The Jawbone of an Ass

points: Samson judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years; he ended up a leadership figure, a judge over Israel.
